missionPremise: A disposition vocabulary that exists at the section/overlay level is unreachable at the leaf. Five instances. X2 edge state and item-4 sourceVintage on absent reads must ship together: shipping one leaves the identical hole one field over. Type, not a check. PE copy is a scope defect, not a wording defect. Customer-done is a live brief plus a deployed bundle marker; this lane does not deploy and coordinates the marker with Gate 8 via leave_behind.
completionPredicate: Done when (1) DrawEdge is a discriminated union and a refuted neighbour cannot type as present; (2) a gold reciprocal neighbour may stay present; (3) absent flood/well/specialDistrict/pipeline-plain with a known vintage emit absent-verified and without one emit unknown, through parcelDrawFromReads not only assembleParcelDraw; (4) attrs.landUse.desc and .taxYear populate from bake keys description/vintage; (5) yearBuilt bake fallback is gone; (6) manifestLayers refuses honestly instead of reading a nulled envelope; (7) sourceAdapter is on the wire; (8) frame.anchor is an absolute lat/lng or explicit null; (9) neighbor is always a field (string | null), never omitted; (10) PE patches and Gate 8 bundle-marker request are leave_behind files, not landed in hauska-map; (11) tsc fails on the old present-only shape and passes after the witness is required. Not done: commit, push, deploy, live brief grade, atom mint.
scopeBasis: Dispatch items 1-4. In scope: parcelDrawStub.ts, parcelDrawFromReads.ts, propertyExplorer.ts manifestLayers, typed-absence sourceVintage on flood/pipeline/well/specialDistrict reads, BoundaryEdgeItem.sourceAdapter passthrough, tests, PE leave_behind patches, Gate 8 marker leave_behind. Out of scope: P1 retired-edge filter (other LDT tree), adjacencyKind⇒neighbour NULL (measured and refused), neighbour-label repair, GIS/bake-ring copy onto property-boundary-edge, atom mint, PE wiring card, deploy, hauska-map checkout edits.

drawEdgeUnion.presentWithNeighbor: state present + neighbor: string + reciprocity: 'pass' — the witness that forces tsc to reject the old {state:'present'} literal
drawEdgeUnion.presentWithoutNeighbor: state present + neighbor: null — edge geometry only; no neighbour claim to verify
drawEdgeUnion.unknown: neighbour id present and nobody cross-checked (live path default; X1 is not wired)
drawEdgeUnion.refused: payload positively contradicts (self-neighbour, or neighborCheck.result=contradicted) + agentGuidance
drawEdgeUnion.neighborAlwaysKeyed: neighbor: string | null on every arm. Stop ...(neighbor ? {neighbor} : {})

design.sourceVintageTogether: FloodHazardFactTypedAbsence / PipelineFactTypedAbsence / WellFactTypedAbsence / SpecialDistrictFactTypedAbsence gain sourceVintage from the atom body. parcelDrawFromReads floodInput/pipelineInput/wellInput/specialDistrictInput pass it. assembleParcelDraw already calls verifiedAbsence; the hole is the fromReads drop.

oneLiners.landUseDesc: landUseAttrs also reads bake key description
oneLiners.landUseTaxYear: landUseAttrs also reads bake key vintage when it is a 4-digit year
oneLiners.yearBuilt: delete yearBuiltFromBake; only structural cad_property; wire carries source cad_property
oneLiners.manifestLayers: stop reading stripped facets.envelope.geojson; refuse with envelopeBriefRefusal.reason. Empty-by-construction is replaced by a named refuse

sourceAdapterAndAnchor.sourceAdapter: read per-edge from the atom body onto BoundaryEdgeItem, always emit on DrawEdge
sourceAdapterAndAnchor.anchor: frame.anchor = {lat, lng} from snapshot.queryPoint, or null. Do not invent

peLeaveBehind.scopeNotWording: coverageFooterLine and the grey-box heading say this parcel, not this area. Do not rewrite the setbacks half as a unit — Rainmaker no-setback-row is true
peLeaveBehind.landUseZone: inspectHighLevelLabel('landUse') returns Land use, not Zone
peLeaveBehind.a1a1: fact-sheet-resolver stops description: landUseLabel ?? landUseCode. Empty description lets sheet-to-card-model render the code alone
peLeaveBehind.yearBuiltSource: do not render a bare yearBuilt; carry source (cad_property vs listing) so 48021:8715051 cannot show 2021 and 2022 as one number

design.tscEvidencePlan: Widen the type so present+string-neighbour requires reciprocity:'pass'. Run tsc against a fixture that is the old {state:'present'} shape; that must fail. Production assembleParcelDraw supplies the witness; tsc then passes.

adversarial.risk1: Defaulting every live neighbour to unknown hides the 741 reciprocal golds until X1 is wired. Accepted: emitting present without a second derivation is the defect. Gold fixture attests reciprocity; live path does not invent it.
adversarial.risk2: P1-LDT is widening the same union in another tree. Collision on merge. Accepted: this tree is separate; planner lands; leave_behind names the overlap.
adversarial.risk3: Adding sourceVintage to typed-absence types without reading the body starves the field. Mitigated: interpretAbsence/interpretBody reads body.sourceVintage the same way present already does.
